properties.context: cypherlite 0.12.0 (release run 38250711636) lands ADR-0200: the store path moves to -d/--database, the first positional becomes the statement, and piped stdin requires the query verb. The old DB-first form hard-fails, so every documented and executed invocation in gbuild must move.
properties.destination: Every cypherlite invocation in gbuild — skill docs, reference, README, script comments, and the contract-test harness — uses the 0.12.0 CLI shape (query verb, --database flag), and the cypher+smoke tests pass against the 0.12.0 binary.
out_of_scope: any change to the .cypher scripts themselves (the query language is unchanged)
supporting both pre- and post-0.12.0 CLI forms
changes to the cypherlite repo itself

properties.text: No cypherlite invocation anywhere in plugins/gbuild (skills, reference, README, templates, cypher/*.cypher comments, cypher.test.ts) uses the pre-0.12 database-as-first-positional form; scripted invocations are cypherlite query --database DB ... and one-shots are cypherlite query "STMT" --database DB ...
plugins/gbuild/cypher.test.ts and smoke.test.ts pass with the cypherlite 0.12.0 binary first on PATH.

The documented minimum cypherlite version is 0.12.0 (reference/cypher.md and README.md), and reference/cypher.md documents post-0.11.8 exit codes (5 = lock/write conflict, 6 = rejected statement, 2 = usage) replacing the exit-1-only wording.

acceptance: plugins/gbuild/cypher.test.ts run() spawns cypherlite with argv ["query", "--database", db, "--mode", "jsonl", ...] and keeps stdin input
no spawnSync call in cypher.test.ts passes the db path as the first positional argument
nothing else in cypher.test.ts changes: same tests, same assertions, same scripts driven
